notes.title: Version 0.0.5 Release
notes.content:
With version 0.0.5, expect waves of undead trying to destroy what is left of mankind.
Fight the waves and see if you can discover the reason behind earth's demise!

notes.title: Version 0.0.3 Release
notes.content:
Heyoooo guys ːsteamhappyː

Welcome to the version 0.0.3 release, in this version I've added a few new updates, and some new level designs! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Once again, thank you so much for your support! I've been enjoying this journey immensely and cannot wait to see where Black Sails takes us!

notes.title: Version 0.0.2 Release
notes.content:
The first update is live!

With the first update, I've added a few new changes to the starting map and introduced loading screens, yes, yes, this doesn't sound like too much of a change, but believe me the difference will be seen!

Thank you all for the continued support!

Friendliest regards,
Arno

notes.title: Version 0.0.1 Release
notes.content:
Welcome to Black Sails' first alpha release! ːwinter2019happyyulː

I'm excited to announce that the base mechanics of the game have been completed and play testing can now commence! ːsteamhappyː


In the first release of the game, start playing around with the mechanics, create a server or join one, fight your friends or the competitive AI and see what the landscape has to offer! ːsteamhappyː

Thank you so much for supporting me on this awesome journey! As you may know I am a solo indie developer on this game, and really want to make it cool, fun, competitive and create an awesome community. It might feel that the game does not have a lot to offer at the moment, but I have so many plans for it! There might be a few bugs here and there so please let me know.

Let's make Black Sails GREAT!

So please join our Discord and let me know what you think!

Yours sincerely, 
Arno
